_comment: Real output, captured on 2026-08-23. Nothing here is hand-written or edited.
Reproduce it with:  npm run studio -- AAPL     (the collector, at a terminal)
npm run e2e:studio         (the same collector, driven by the extension)
npm run e2e                (a tab scan, no Bright Data involved)

scraper_studio_collector_row._comment: One row exactly as the published Bright Data Scraper Studio collector returns it. Collector c_mt5eiyxpq0ed8wn9v, snapshot j_mt6022v2x0fytbxyi.

snapshot._comment: The canonical shape everything downstream reads. A collector row and a tab scan both normalize to this, which is why the two are interchangeable. `method` records which route produced it; `selectors_used` is empty for a collector row because no DOM was read on this machine.
news: Apple cutting hundreds more jobs in shift toward AI
Apple (AAPL) Lays Off Over 200 Employees as It Refocuses on AI and New Devices

snapshot_from_a_tab_scan._comment: The same shape from the other route. Here the page was read in the browser, so every number carries the DOM hook that produced it — that map is the audit trail shown under 'Selectors used' in the popup.
news: Apple cutting hundreds more jobs in shift toward AI

advisory._comment: What the engine proposes. `user_action_required` is always true — the extension has no path to a broker, and this object is a suggestion until a person confirms it.
advisory.rationale: AAPL trades at $309.35, down 0.63% with volume 48.59M. You hold no shares and have no buy-or-sell targets set, so there is insufficient guidance to act. Given the modest decline and lack of user-defined thresholds, a neutral HOLD is advised.

decision._comment: What is written when the person confirms. `executed: false` is not a placeholder for a later true — no code sets it, because nothing is ever executed.
decision.rationale: AAPL trades at $309.35, down 0.63% with volume 48.59M...

healed_selector_registry._comment: What the repair loop learned, keyed by host and field. A selector only lands here after the model proposed it, it resolved on the live page, and the value it returned fit the field.

repair_log_entries._comment: An accepted repair. `reason` is the model's own words, kept so a person can judge the fix rather than trust it.
repair_log_entries.reason: Div showing the regular-market change "-1.95 (-0.63%)" which includes the percentage

repair_log_entries._comment: A refused one, from a run where the model proposed the price node for the volume field. It resolved, and was still wrong — so it never reached the registry.
repair_log_entries.reason: The live value node carries the hashed class.
repair_log_entries.error: selector matched, but "$182.44" is not a valid volume

suggested_targets._comment: Arithmetic on the user's own data — scan history first, then their approved BUY decisions, then cost basis. No model is asked what a stock is worth.
suggested_targets.note: Anchored on 5 scans averaging 100, with a 7.1% band from the 7.1% spread of those scans.
